## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [若那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8B%A5%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) Jñānabhadra is the *latter section* of the *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra* — additional Indic material continuing the narrative of the Buddha's last discourses beyond what is contained in Dharmakṣema's *Northern Recension* (*Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 [KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001), T0374). The text provides further material on the Buddha's *parinirvāṇa* and the disposition of his relics.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Jñānabhadra's Táng activity (660–700 CE).
